# Pull Request

## Description
Provide a clear description of the changes made in this PR and why they are necessary.

Closes #(issue_number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feature`: New Feature or Functionality
- [ ] `bug`: Bug fix or defect correction
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, CI, tooling, or refactoring
- [ ] `docs`: Update documentation

## Verification & Testing
Describe the tests conducted to verify your changes.

- [ ] Unit tests pass cleanly (`go test ./...`)
- [ ] Race detector passed (`go test -race ./...`)
- [ ] Formatting verified (`gofumpt -l .`)
- [ ] Linter passed (`golangci-lint run`)
